title: Spring at the Park
text:
Lucy goes to the park in spring. The flowers are pink and yellow. She plays on the swings with her brother.

In summer, the park is hot and full of people. Lucy and her brother eat ice cream on the grass. In winter, the park is quiet because it is cold.

questions.text: Where does Lucy go in spring?
What do Lucy and her brother eat in summer?
Why is the park quiet in winter?
How does Lucy probably feel about the park?

vocabulary.definition: the colorful parts of a plant that grow in spring and summer
seats hanging from ropes that children move back and forth on
the green plant that covers the ground in a park

paragraph_translations: Lucy vai ao parque na primavera. As flores são cor-de-rosa e amarelas. Ela brinca nos balanços com o irmão.
No verão, o parque é quente e cheio de pessoas. Lucy e o irmão comem sorvete na grama. No inverno, o parque fica silencioso porque está frio.
